subject: [PATCH v2 2/3] mm/page_alloc: move the kswapd node skip check into a helper

2026-11-16.patch_summary: This patch refactors the kswapd node skip check in the Linux kernel's page allocation code into a separate helper function called should_skip_kswapd_zone(). This makes the zone iteration cleaner and easier to read, while also resolving a checkpatch warning. The new function checks if kswapd is active on a node and if the zone is below its watermark for this request, and returns true if it should skip the zone. No functional changes are intended by this patch.
